gizmo.title: Ƙetare kalmomi
gizmo.description: Ƙetare kalmomi da aka yi daga jerin kalmomi da alamu. Ana samar maka da grid ɗin; masu koyo suna rubuta kalmomin kuma suna duba su.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Take ko tambayar da ake nunawa a saman ƙetare kalmomin.

configure.title: Kalmomi
configure.description: Kowace kalma da alamarta. Ana samar da grid daga wannan jeri: ana sanya kalma mafi tsayi da farko kuma sauran suna ƙetare ta a kan haruffan da aka raba.

advanced.title: Ƙoƙari
advanced.description: Sau nawa mai koyo zai iya dubawa. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka.

advanced.title: Launin ƙawa
advanced.description: Launi na zaɓi don guntun kai, kalmar da ke aiki da maɓallan aiki.

advanced.title: Ana iya naɗewa
advanced.description: Nuna wannan ƙetare kalmomi a matsayin layi da ke buɗewa da rufewa. Buɗe ɗaya yana rufe sauran tambayoyin da ake iya naɗewa da ke kusa da shi.

advanced.title: Fara a naɗe
advanced.description: Idan ana iya naɗewa, fara a matsayin layi a rufe da ke nuna take da matsayinsa kawai.

advanced.title: Tsarin bayar da maki
advanced.description: OER Schema: tsarin bayar da maki don wannan kimantawa (misali maki, harafi, kashi, kammalawa).

advanced.title: Manufar koyo
advanced.description: OER Schema: manufar koyo da ke da alaƙa da wannan kimantawa.

developer.title: Sunan tambayoyin
developer.description: Sunan tambayoyin da ake amfani da shi don gano xAPI a tsarin nazari.

developer.title: Kwas
developer.description: OER Schema: kwas ɗin da aka yi wannan kimantawa domin shi.
